title: Chapter 203 Incomplete Report (V)
content:
Chapter 203 Incomplete Report (V)

Without water, she was like a weaponless person, and her fighting power was about the same as that of an ordinary skeleton soldier.

Wang Shuo took out the flaming spear and stabbed her chest.

"Iron Chain Binding", "Flame Breath", "Dragon Strike".

Three skills were activated at the same time.

Although Xia Qi tried her best to dodge, she was still fixed in her body. The flaming spear pierced her left waist, taking away thousands of her health points.

Then Ayub and Gong Zheng joined in, each with a set of skills, and Xia Qi was directly half-blooded.

Guliji and Li Jianguo also rushed over, but there were people who were faster than them.

Ye Xueer also drew out her long sword and attacked Xia Qi crazily, more fiercely than Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo turned his head and looked.

Ye Xueer's clothes had been dried, and her hair was no longer wet.

A butterfly-shaped hairpin was inserted into the bun, and there were a few strands of hair flying on her chest and back, looking bright and beautiful.

A few more swords.

Xia Qi was chopped into pieces by the angry crowd.

Seeing that there was an incomplete report among the items that exploded, Wang Shuo picked it up without hesitation.

[Obtained the incomplete report (V), the side quest is 45% complete. ]

The animation unfolds.

Within the jurisdiction of Black Dragon City, a large number of villages and towns were attacked by countless undead armies.

The screen quickly switched between towns and villages.

Smoke rose everywhere, the war continued, the people cried and ran, and the soldiers shed blood on the battlefield.

Countless altars were surrounded by death, and a steady stream of skeleton soldiers walked out of the altars.

Immediately afterwards, Black Dragon City sent millions of troops to various battlefields.

Although the army of Black Dragon City fought bravely, it could not withstand the undead army. There were too many of them, and the number was increasing.

Some soldiers who had been fighting against the undead for a long time were also attacked by the death energy. At first, there was nothing, but as time went on, they also began to transform into undead.

As a result, the number of human soldiers began to decrease sharply, and people had to be sent to take care of the undead soldiers.

The Black Dragon City army was defeated.

The scene ended.

It seems that the undead army has become a force to be reckoned with. If heavy troops were sent to suppress it at the beginning, how could it be like this?

Wang Shuo was a little distressed.

But on the other hand, who could have predicted it?

It's like a grocery store opened in the next village. How could those big tycoons spend all their money to destroy a small grocery store?

It can only be said that everything has its own destiny.

Wang Shuo looked at Ye Xueer and asked awkwardly, "Why don't you pick it first?"

After the danger was temporarily lifted, the two felt a little embarrassed again.

After a brief hesitation, Ye Xueer picked up a piece of equipment that fell.

Wang Shuo picked up a scroll - "Occupation Forgotten Scroll".

[Occupation Forgotten Scroll: After using it, you can forget the chosen profession and relearn a new profession. 】

This scroll is a second chance for those who want to change their profession!

Wang Shuo looked at the remaining energy crystals and soul crystals, and said to Ye Xueer: "Put these away too!"

After saying that, Wang Shuo turned and left.

Ye Xueer blushed, and without refusing, she put away all the items.

Locke and the other two were envious of Ye Xueer's harvest!

They all regretted not flying over and stabbing twice, so that they would have a reason to share the spoils.

When they came to the shore, Wang Shuo looked at the map and determined the next place to explore - the research institute.
